gaps.sentence: The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.
They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).

gaps.explanation: 'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.
